title: A message lasts half as long on a lit level
description: Level 4 of the Mines loads as a snake pit, with the message "I HEAR SNAKES... I HATE SNAKES!". The level is lit, so the message is gone after 100 steps, about three seconds, where a dark level's lasts 200.
